description: This file contains a Swift extension of OnboardingView that defines the layout and UI logic for an onboarding process, including navigation controls, page management, and various UI components.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for the onboarding screen, including layout, animations, and event handling.

methods.name: activePageIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current page index based on the cursor position, ensuring it is within valid bounds.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange
methods.description: Adjusts the current page to an appropriate page index when the connection mode changes.

methods.name: onboardingPage
methods.description: Provides a standardized scrollable container for onboarding content pages.

methods.name: onboardingCard
methods.description: Creates a styled card view with optional padding and spacing, used for displaying grouped content.

methods.name: onboardingGlassCard
methods.description: Creates a stylized transparent or semi-transparent card with overlay and border effects.

methods.name: featureRow
methods.description: Builds a UI row with icon, title, subtitle, typically for feature descriptions.

methods.name: featureActionRow
methods.description: Builds an action-oriented feature row with a button.

methods.name: featureRowContent
methods.description: Helper method to generate the content inside feature rows, with optional action.
